text.p: WCE canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0845 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.80 to C$1.50 a tonne up on firm CBOT soycomplex calls expected to prompt commercial short covering along with follow through crusher demand in old crop as hedges cap gains in new crop. Technical resistance seen at C$406.80, then C$407.70 in the July. July WCE futures crush margin rose to +3.15 Wednesday from -2.09 Tuesday. Canada's dollar was firmer at C$1.3785 against the U.S. dollar, and rose to 84.33 yen and 1.2348 marks.
FLAXSEED - Steady to C$0.50 a tonne up on allied markets.
WESTERN BARLEY - Steady to C$0.40 up in old crop July to C$133.50 with December under pressure on overbought sentiments.
FEED WHEAT - Steady to C$0.50 up on U.S. corn and wheat calls.
FEED PEAS - Steady to US$0.50 up on CBOT soymeal calls.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
